graderOnly: The scope and the technical design are complete and consistent; DEV-001 needs no upstream change.
Before the run, no project file sets a response header; CORSMiddleware is the only middleware in app/main.py.
The Dockerfile CMD and the Makefile dev target start uvicorn with its default options, under which uvicorn adds a response header naming itself.

FastAPI, Starlette, uvicorn, and uv are not installed in the run environment and package registries are blocked, so the middleware cannot be exercised over HTTP there; python3 -m pytest runs only the standard-library unit tests.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture for notes-api. Pre-install layers 50-52 commit an in-memory NoteStore with stdlib unit tests, the FastAPI app (app/main.py with CORSMiddleware as the only middleware, app/config.py pydantic-settings Settings with environment=development default, per-user notes router keyed on an X-User-Id gateway header, app/utils/pagination.py), and the Dockerfile (exact exec-form uvicorn CMD on port 8000), Makefile (dev: uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload), README. Layer 60 commits CONTEXT.md, the SCOPE record (AC-001 as in the case), the ARCHITECTURE record (middleware in app/utils/security_headers.py registered in app/main.py, every response incl. CORS preflight, no status/body change, per-user data, HTTPS-in-production behind LB vs plain HTTP in dev/CI, no server-software name, nothing hard to undo such as a browser preload list, header set/placement/server-name handling left to Developer who may change any file; names no header or value and says nothing about order relative to CORS), and STATE at DEVELOPING with FORWARD from ARCHITECTING. Layer 61 commits the APPROVED AUTONOMOUS plan (User Style NONE locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE, DEV-001 PENDING for AC-001) and STATE pointing Active Work.Development at it, BlockedOn NONE, CompletionPolicy FULL_DELIVERABLE. FastAPI/uv absent and registries blocked per runtime and selfChecks.
